advisory_text: Based on your field near Belagavi, soil moisture is moderate and the NDVI trend (0.41) shows healthy vegetation recovery since your last cotton harvest. With light rain expected over the next week, this is a good window to prepare land for groundnut sowing. Avoid heavy irrigation until after the rain passes. Consider ragi as a low-risk alternative if rainfall is delayed.
